subject: op-spd
title: OP.SPD.------SOC.RT.DY.
description: Diagram in CMOA(II)-13 (Creative Music Outside of America, Level One — France/Italy/Northern Europe/Japan) accompanying Braxton's claim about French creative musicians' dilemma: 'the social-reality realness of France does not move to necessarily give the native French musician — and/or collective — the same regard that is generally acknowledged in other areas of its greater cultural creativity.' (C)OP-SPD (the concept of option-spread) is crossed with SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics): the question is what option-spread produces when crossed with social-reality-dynamics — under conditions where French social-reality-dynamics gives international musicians more regard than native ones. RT-DY (reality dynamics) branches from the main line; C-CONT (composite continuance) branches from RT-DY to the upper-left margin, and INT (intention) and ATT (attitude) branch from C-CONT. SOC-RT-DY itself is partner. PART (participation) branches from the main line to the right; INDIV-DY-RT (individual dynamic reality) branches from PART, AF-NT (affinity-nature) branches from INDIV-DY-RT, and PRI-INFO (principle information) branches from AF-NT. Structural argument: option-spread-as-concept crossed with social-reality-dynamics carries two side chains: reality-dynamics leading to composite-continuance on the left, and participation leading through individual-dynamic-reality and affinity-nature to principle-information on the right. The diagram exposes Braxton's structural diagnostic of the French dilemma: the social-reality-dynamics tone privileges the imported over the indigenous.
